Blum: the 2020/21 catalogue (S03) does NOT contain a SPACE CORNER detail page (only the overview p268 and ORGA-LINE sets); the official SPACE CORNER with SYNCROMOTION installation instruction MA-493/0 (S01) was downloaded and read incl. drawings. A planning sheet with cabinet-width limits for SPACE CORNER was not found; blum.com download page lists only 4 PDFs and no CAD (S22). No 'LEGRABOX pull-out for corner' or 'Blum CARGO' exists in the documents found.
Blum SPACE TOWER: official planning information TD-082/4 (S02) read; shows pull-out height positions and hinge drilling, no order codes (assembled from box-system parts).

Source conflict: Peka Magic Corner Comfort load 8 kg (front) / 10 kg (rear) per shelf and 36 kg total (S12, S14a) vs Kesseboehmer-branded 'Magic Corner' in the Demos catalogue 7/9 kg per basket, 14/18 kg per pair (S11 p33) - different product/era; both recorded.
Source conflict: Hettich shop product page Salso 9381054 (S16): inside height 620-780 and min depth 460, vs official catalogue S15 p14/16: 620-820 and 465 (catalogue used).

Source conflict/info: Dispensa VVS-x 120 kg 'own weight + load' and 18 kg per basket (MA 402053, S10) vs 100 kg slide/load (Demos catalogue S11 p15, kesseboehmer.com teaser S21) - not inconsistent if frame weight about 20 kg.
Source conflict: Grass Quaturis 75 LTK for sets 3/4 = 515/525 (S19 p16) vs Vauth-Sagel VS COR Spin 900 B = 512/522 (S20b p1); sets 1/2 identical (500/510). Symbols differ (LTK vs B).
Hettich Orta table prints a row '550' (S15 p20) although front widths are 400/450/500/600; recorded as printed.

LeMans II is marketed under the Kesseboehmer brand (also in Hettich's range per S17 and Haefele); Kesseboehmer catalogue letters A-K (S06 p4) differ from MA letters A-D (S07 p3): catalogue A (>=764) = MA C; catalogue C (361-368) = MA A; catalogue F (<=400) = MA B. Values agree.

The Kesseboehmer 2013 catalogue pages (S06) are old; MA 402118 is dated 2012; MA 402121 Rev 007-2018 (S09) is a different (North American) installation sheet with lower minimum widths (e.g. door 400: 355/362 mm vs 361-368 mm in the EU sheet) - recorded as a separate product entry.

Distributor catalogues used (not manufacturer-issued): Blum catalogue copy (ldlonline), Kesseboehmer LeMans pages (megaflis.no), Demos Trade K05 2024 (Kesseboehmer products with Demos codes; codes are Demos article numbers, Kesseboehmer code given where printed), Haefele UK catalogue pages, GRASS Quaturis brochure copy (2015). Official manufacturer PDFs: Blum MA-493, TD-082, Hettich catalogue 2025, Peka data sheets and MAs, Vauth-Sagel manuals, Kesseboehmer MAs.

Not found / not covered: Peka LeMans (none), Rev-A-Shelf (no document retrieved), Kesseboehmer 'Cargo'-type bottle pull-outs (only Peka Pinello Cargo and Hettich/Kesseboehmer 150 mm base baskets found), Hettich tall-unit pantry beyond Olona/Iseo, Haefele's own Dispensa order codes (only Kesseboehmer/Demos codes), Vauth-Sagel LeMans (not a VS product), VS TAL/Variant pantry (nothing retrieved), Grass SIGE (Discover 2024 PDF URL returned 404).
